brief.en: Plant it on a grave to remove the grave
brief.zh: 种植在墓碑上并移除这块墓碑

description.en: Grave Busters consume graves they're planted on.
description.zh: 将噬碑藤种在墓碑上，他们会啃食掉这块墓碑。

chat.en: He may appear spiky or ill-tempered, but Grave Buster just wants to give you a big hug. Unless you're a puppy. He's terrified of those.
chat.zh: 他可能看上去凶巴巴坏脾气，但是噬碑藤只是想要给你一个大大的拥抱。除非你是一只小狗，他很害怕小狗！

text.en: single use, must be planted on graves
text.zh: 一次性使用，必须种植在墓碑上
